method: Complete Frost reference request (inventory/first-frost), 3000 iterations, seed 42, first-fight debug log on. Go: the pinned engine's RunRaidSim through tools/oracle-v2 sim, GOMAXPROCS=1, one process per sample, elapsedNs from the result. Rust: forever-engine bench on the frost-reference prepared fixture, 3 in-process warmups, elapsed_ns of the iteration loop. Both produce DPS 590.9470407845581.
limitations: Shared host without CPU affinity; few samples; Go times include per-process warmup effects that Rust's in-process warmups avoid; Rust excludes JSON parsing and Go preparation, which the exporter performs. One build and one request; not a production or multi-spec claim.
